Disneyland Resort Welcomes One Billionth Guest

Seven decades of happiness. One billion guests from around the world. Countless magical memories. Disneyland Resort commemorated welcoming 1 billion guests to Disneyland park and Disney California Adventure park with a ceremony at the entrance of Disneyland. Over seven decades, the resort has created magical memories for families from around the world, reinforcing its legacy
